name: Shirakawa Komine Castle
description: Shirakawa Komine Castle was a strategic gate-castle on the Oshu Kaido guarding the route north. Its three-story keep was rebuilt in 1991 using traditional stone-masonry techniques; the stone walls survive from the Edo period.
highlights: Gate castle of the Oshu Kaido
notes: The keep interior is open (¥320 adult, closed Mon). Free to walk the grounds.
